property_summary: For any non-zero address newOwner, after the current owner calls transferOwnership(newOwner), the new owner must be able to renounce ownership, leaving owner() == address(0); the mutant never updates _owner, so the designated new owner's renounceOwnership reverts and owner() stays the old owner.
change_summary: Remove the _transferOwnership call so owner() remains unchanged after transferOwnership.
